bounded_conclusion.ruled_out: These three trained full-history actor packages do not deliver the frozen useful gain over the incumbent; all beat usage but nonlinear laws are effectively tied with native. The converged conditional logit loses.
bounded_conclusion.unresolved: Both nonlinear fits hit1500selection rounds; incumbent/common information packages and actor-time phase differ. No architecture/data/predictability ceiling, and no established explanation of C05 critical-player harm.
bounded_conclusion.conditional_discriminator: If actor work resumes later, prospectively cross training-only convergence continuation with native-information parity; do not call C06 rescued.
bounded_conclusion.selected_next_bottleneck: C05 has actual overall player-point signal but critical-player harm. C07 compares coherent whole-game/team/player expert combination with earlier-only learned gates, fixed guards and final returned-world evaluation.
